Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::generateLoanAgreement(): Boolean {
	definition:
		newLoanAgreement: LoanAgreement = LoanAgreement()
	precondition:
		CurrentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let newLoanAgreement: LoanAgreement in
		newLoanAgreement.oclIsNew() and
		LoanAgreement.allInstance()->includes(newLoanAgreement) and
		CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanAgreement = newLoanAgreement
}
